lede: Ohio State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +11.1 against -0.4, a 11.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Iowa +7.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ohio State winning 70% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
